utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara—if you can bring a power drill and a few screwdrivers, that’d be a big help. If you’ve got time, we could also use an extra pair of hands sorting the parts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll bring a power drill and some screwdrivers, and I can help sort the parts too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Hana — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you first confirm what time the repair drive starts and whether you need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking the start time now, and I’ll let you know if you need to bring anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—what do you need me to watch for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — if you spot any screws, duct tape, or spare paint, let me know. I’ve got a bad habit of missing things, so I really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for screws, duct tape, and spare paint, and I’ll let you know right away if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m still trying to sort out the logistics and make sure we have enough supplies and a clear schedule. If you can help with organizing the drop-off times, that would really ease my mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can help organize the drop-off times. Send me whatever details you have, and I’ll keep it tidy.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any tools or volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I’m not totally sure, but that’s what I heard. I could definitely use a volunteer or two, and maybe a basic tool kit if anyone has one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support—sounds like folks around here are really pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been great to see everyone chip in. If you need a tool or a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I can bring a basic tool kit and help on Saturday. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track where the repair drive is headed—do you know the first stop yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — I heard the first stop is the community center. I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Bo—much appreciated. I’ll keep the list updated, so send anyone my way as you hear of them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll send people your way as I hear of them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting together the repair drive list now, Bo—if you know anyone with a broken step, leaky tap, or busted light, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and send folks your way if I hear of any busted steps, leaks, or lights.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I was just thinking about something else. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s really kind of you, Gus—I'll keep that in mind. I’m glad the whole neighborhood is pulling together for it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to hear it, Vik. I’ll keep to the plan and bring my part by on repair drive day.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and save you a spot whenever you get there. Thanks, Dane!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s alright, Uli — low-key helps just fine. If you can spare even a little, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great — I can ask around when I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep you posted if I hear back from anyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please do — I’ll probably join a bit late, but I’d like to help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Could you make a quick list of what still needs fixing and what supplies we’re short on?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’m happy to help get the repair drive going. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be really helpful, Faye — thank you. I’ll make sure the repair drive schedule fits around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times if that makes the repair drive easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Can you confirm what kind of help you’re offering for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and repeat the plan to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. Could you let me know which tools you’re bringing so I can make sure we don’t end up short on anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, a tape measure, and my cordless drill. If you still need anything else, I can grab that too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location—do you want me to check where it’s being held?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s kind of you, Rey. We still need a few hands for sorting donations and setting up the tables—if you can come by around 9, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can come by around 9 and help sort donations and set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the details first. What time and location is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you check what supplies we already have and note anything we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’ve already got and make a note of anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that’s what I heard too — it’s still on, but I’m only going by second-hand updates. If you hear anything official, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already—people are bringing tools, paint, and a few snacks too. If you’re heading over, I’d go early so you can catch the organizers before it gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh? Is that confirmed, or just a rumor? If it’s really starting that soon, I might swing by early.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — if I hear any news, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m ready to help out, I just need a little reminder of what we’re collecting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re collecting tools, tape, batteries, and any spare parts people can donate.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—tools, tape, batteries, and spare parts. I’ll spread the word and see what folks can bring over.
